description: This file defines the UserController class for handling user-related HTTP requests such as retrieving current user details and updating user information within a web API framework.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core controller handling user-related endpoints, utilizing dependency injection of IMediator and ICurrentUserAccessor for processing requests.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve the current user's details using the mediator pattern.

methods.name: UpdateUser
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update the current user's information, accepting a command object and forwarding it via the mediator.
